steps.title: Request code
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.
actions: POST /auth/email/request synthetic address and proof challenge

expectations.description: Returns a challenge and expiry, and delivers exactly one synthetic mailbox code.

mappings.why: Mixed-case padded input is returned normalized and delivered to the matching local mailbox; only this valid address is exercised. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

A configured binding and valid synthetic address/challenge reach successful request; invalid and absent branches are not established here. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

A successful request returns an opaque challenge and delivers a six-digit value; randomness quality is not established. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

The first request reserves a challenge and invokes the local mailbox; the observable request and later successful verification do not separately attest each storage field. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

The returned challenge, future expiry and resend time are asserted, without proving exact durations. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

The local RPC receives the expected synthetic recipient, sender, subject and text code; HTML rendering and real provider delivery are not asserted. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

steps.title: Reject resend
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.
actions: POST /auth/email/request same address and proof during cooldown

expectations.description: Enforces resend cooldown without a second delivery.

mappings.why: A repeated same-address same-proof request returns 429 during cooldown with no second local delivery; the fixture is below address and IP quotas. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

steps.title: Reject wrong code
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.

mappings.why: An intentionally different code with the correct proof fails and the later correct verification succeeds; the assertion does not inspect attempts or max-attempt behavior. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

steps.title: Reject wrong proof
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.

expectations.description: Rejects the correct code with a mismatched proof key.

mappings.why: Correct code with a different valid verifier fails; the later success shows this attempt did not consume the challenge. Race and lockout behavior are not established. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

steps.title: Verify code
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.

expectations.description: Issues a session for the normalized synthetic email after successful proof.

mappings.why: The valid code and proof lead to the successful consumption path; no race, attempt-limit or expiry behavior is asserted. Narrow local association only; not measured execution.
The first successful verification returns a user for the normalized address; this alone does not prove every database insert condition. Narrow local association only; not measured execution.
A later distinct proof verifies to the same user; individual identity-table rows are not independently inspected. Narrow local association only; not measured execution.

Successful verification issues a bearer session later used to read identity and device sessions; token hashing and exact database contents are not directly inspected. Narrow local association only; not measured execution.
The successful verification returns a token, future expiry and normalized user; exact expiry duration is not asserted. Narrow local association only; not measured execution.

steps.title: Reject replay
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.

expectations.description: Rejects reuse of the consumed challenge.

mappings.why: The consumed challenge cannot mint another session when replayed serially; races and expiry are untested. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

The replay returns invalid_code; the assertion cannot distinguish all causes of that shared error. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

steps.title: Read identity
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.

mappings.why: The issued token resolves to the asserted user and session; invalid bearer syntax and independent expiry cases are not tested. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

The authenticated identity readback returns this user and empty team/project lists in the synthetic fixture. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

steps.title: Read two sessions

mappings.why: The first authenticated device revokes its own second device; other-user ownership and real-time connection effects are not established. This is a narrow association for this synthetic local outcome, not measured execution or proof of unobserved branches.

steps.title: Logout
preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.

preconditions: Isolated local synthetic mailbox and real Worker HTTP; preceding ordered steps succeeded.
